column2: Conjugate symmetry: X[N−k] = conj(X[k]). Only bins 0…N/2 carry independent information.

column2: N/2 at bins k and N−k, 0 elsewhere.

column1: Why bit reversal in an iterative FFT?
column2: Decimation in time recursively splits into even and odd indices; doing that log₂N times leaves the inputs in bit-reversed order, so you permute first and combine in place.

Why does pitch.ts use getFloatTimeDomainData, not the analyser's FFT?
column2: It needs the raw samples to compute its own autocorrelation (NSDF) with sub-sample interpolation. The analyser's magnitude spectrum is smoothed, in dB, and limited to bin resolution.

column1: E2E test waits: why expect.poll / toHaveText, not waitForTimeout?
column2: Fixed sleeps are slow when things are fast and flaky when things are slow. Polling an assertion waits exactly as long as needed, up to a timeout.
